scope: Signed native E1 transition-component audit of the EXISTING sealed v41 CI/rate models: 4 orbital models x 2 gauges, all 5 E1 channels from upper 3S1 (level 6) to lower levels 0-4. No new SCF, CI, Hamiltonian, correlation/core/radial expansion, rates, lifetime or grade.
source_basis: Pinned TRMultipole sums AngularZMix(lower,upper,2,2) coefficients x MultipoleRadialFR(aw=alpha*(E_up-E_low)) over the photon grid TRTable sets from the requested channels (2-3 points, interpolated). AngularZMix's CSF loop multiplies stored level mixing (truncated at |mix|<1e-5*|principal| then renormalised) by AngularZMixStates CSF-pair angular coefficients, skipping |mix|,|mix1*mix2|,|term|<ANGZCUT=1e-8, merging by orbital pair after qsort, swapping bra/ket by Hamiltonian order. Input sets no AngZ/mix-cut/PrepAngular/max_nbs control, so source defaults apply.
probe_design: Observability-only RawE1Components added to the exact v27 rate frontend (RawTransition/ConfigDiagnostics unchanged); unchanged libfac. Called immediately after the last E1 RawTransition, before the next TransitionTable, i.e. in the native photon-grid/cache context. Logs: photon grid; both levels' stored basis, mixing, configuration labels, stored-vs-Hamiltonian basis counts and norm; the native AngularZMix list in native order with the cached radial and running sum; every CSF-pair angular term INCLUDING terms the native cut drops (flagged, never added). Does NOT call TRMultipole (uninitialised optional selector) and does not use pk0/pk1.
guards: Disposable smoke fixture (4-config O I) already verified the probe outside the sealed models. Canary: new frontend on UNCHANGED v41 input must reproduce every stable v41 file byte-for-byte. Each of 8 cases: declared input = exact v41 input + 5 component calls; v41 CI replay identity; every stable parent file byte-identical including raw.tsv, state/potential/wave/overlap/basis/stdout/stderr (measured null: v36 vs v41 regeneration differ only in input.sf, native.time, o.lev, o.lev.b; rates.tr carries the same session stamp and is checked by the unchanged independent rate audit, which must equal v41). Components: A-order running sum and final amplitude EXACTLY equal native RawTransition amplitude; every product, cut flag and kept-term radial cache value exact; per-orbital-pair CSF sums within the recursive-summation bound gamma_n*sum|x| (u=2^-53, Higham eq. 4.4) because only merge order differs; kept-CSF total within 2*gamma_(N+1)*sum|term|. These are floating-point bounds, not physical tolerances.
analysis: Portable audit decomposes each amplitude by CSF pair, configuration pair and orbital pair; principal-pair share vs its mixing weight; cancellation index sum|t|/|sum t|; angular-cut dropped amplitude; mixing-cut basis counts (dropped weight itself is not recoverable post hoc and is reported as such); grid position and, for the reference 3P2 line only, native-grid radial vs v43 exact own-energy radial; ground-vs-equal and B-vs-C configuration-pair shifts as labelled diagnostics (orbitals differ between models; not an adiabatic overlap proof). No dominance inferred from configuration probability or from the native selector.
resource_policy: Sirius only, sequential, single-thread, nice19; 180s build, 1800s per owned native process group (v41 cases took about 68s each). Stop and preserve first failure; no retry, skip or criterion change without a new declaration. Fresh probe/run directories; original FAC source, library and executables unmodified; sealed v41/v43 runs not rewritten.
tests: 11 local reader/insertion/identity/tamper tests pass 0.05s on the disposable smoke fixture.
evidence: Preserve full native outputs, components, build/diff, index, canary and receipts losslessly in <=5MiB parts with independent decoding before transfer.
